sections.description:
CENTRAL ZAKAT COUNCIL (TRAVELLING AND DAILY ALLOWANCES) RULES, 1979
CENTRAL ZAKAT COUNCIL
(TRAVELLING AND DAILY ALLOWANCES) RULES, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 3rd July 1979]
S. R. O.592(I)/79.-In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 16 of the Zakat and Ushr (Organisation) Ordinance, 1979,
the Central Zakat Council makes the following Rules for the regulation of
travelling and daily allowances of the Chairman and members of the Council,
namely :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) These
rules may called the Central Zakat Council (Travelling and Daily Allowances)
Rules, 1979.
(2) These shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.-In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,-
(i) "Chairman" means the Chairman of the
Council;
(ii) "Council" means the Central Zakat
Council;
(iii) "meeting" means a meeting of the
Council; and
(iv) "member" means a member of the
Council.
3. Travelling and daily
allowances to the Chairman.
-On journeys under taken in connection with the business of the Council, the
Chairman, being a serving or retired Judge of the Supreme Court, shall be
entitled to the same mileage and daily allowances and other travelling
concessions as are admissible to a Judge of the Supreme Court, from time to
time.
4. Travelling and daily
allowances to a member who is serving or retired Judge of Supreme Court/High
Court.-On journeys
undertaken in connection with the business of the Council, a member who is a
serving or retired Judge of the Supreme Court or a High Court, shall be
entitled to the same mileage and daily allowances and other travelling
concessions as are admissible, from time to time, to a Judge of the Supreme
Court or a High Court, as the case may be.
5. Travelling and daily
allowances to non-official member.-On journeys undertaken in connection with the
business of the Council, a member who does not hold an office in the service of
Pakistan, shall be entitled to mileage and daily allowances, including facility
of staying in hotels, but excluding H. O. R. facility, at the rates and terms applicable
to Secretaries to the Federal Government.
6. Travelling and daily
allowances to official members.-On journeys undertaken in connection with the business of the Council,
a member who is holding an office in the service of Pakistan shall be entitled
to mileage and daily allowances and other facilities at the rates as are
applicable to him as such official.
7. Source of payment of
travelling and daily allowances and other facilities/concessions to the
Chairman and members. (1)
The Chairman or a member who does not hold an office in the service of
Pakistan, shall be reimbursed admissible travelling expenses out of a grant to
be made specifically for the purpose, by the Federal Government.
(2) The Chairman or a member who holds an office in
the service of Pakistan, shall be reimbursed admissible travelling expenses by
his parent office.
